name: @superschematic/engine-workqueue
description: Claimable work for @superschematic/engine (D16): the implementations of the core's Lease, an exclusive lease with a fencing token, heartbeats and directives to its holder, and Assignment, which a deployment registers with the engine it opens. Runs on Node.js 24 and Bun. Needs @superschematic/engine next to it in node_modules, the copy the deployment opens; see scripts/link-local-deps.mjs.

scripts.build: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:node && bun run test:bun
scripts.test:bun: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && bun test ./test
